background_renderer_scope.observed_tail_mode: exact original read-combination and resource-format statement spans; supplied read_tail bytes/flags; no filesystem read
background_renderer_scope.stable_full_log_mode: original read and resource_text over closed stable fixture files

dependency_identity_normalization: Resolve each dependency token through its own Cargo.lock into (name, version, source), then require every package name/version/source/checksum and complete dependency identity set equal to the original row. Only Cargo's short-name versus explicit-version syntax may differ.
feature_unification_scope: Explicit direct features reproduce the actual fresh locked production metadata feature union. Existing dependencies aho-corasick/futures-core/futures-sink/once_cell/regex-automata/serde_core/syn/wasm-bindgen/windows-sys plus existing test-transitive bitflags/getrandom/futures-util/js-sys/futures-channel preserve their production features and original resolved dependency edges. No new package identity, version anchor, dependency edge, modified crate or substituted source is introduced.

fixture_scope.background_caller_cancel: does not abort original promote task
fixture_scope.cancel: abort caller task only; original Child kill_on_drop; no implicit kill_all/discard/unregister
fixture_scope.capture_observer: read-only original capture file descriptors; shared input command gate released by controller
fixture_scope.foreground_errno: only original owner error text; optional os_error_from_message explicitly derived
fixture_scope.shutdown: original kill_all_shell_children on explicit shutdown or stdin EOF
fixture_scope.view_cache: original type/derive only; no cache-method substitution or cache qualification

oracle_extra_tokio_feature.reason: Fresh cargo metadata --locked on unchanged production Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock at source_commit reports tokio time and the complete preserved feature union.

production_feature_reproduction: The reference runner materializes these exact source-commit inputs, runs fresh cargo metadata --locked, and checks the recorded production feature union; no production crates are compiled.
